item.title: Competition is not market validation
item.description:
📝 Look at all that competition, you think, the market is clearly validated. However, what does not logically follow is that a high level of competition implies a large market. Startups that should be consulting firms There is a specific type of market where users have real pain-points that almost look the same from 10,000 feet but have material differences when you zoom in.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ablg.io/blog/competition-is-not-validation

item.title: Show HN: Clawe – open-source Trello for agent teams
item.description:
📝 🦞 Clawe A multi-agent coordination system powered by OpenClaw. sh └── templates/ # Agent workspace templates CLI Commands Agents use the clawe CLI to interact with the coordination system: # Check for notifications clawe check # List tasks clawe tasks clawe tasks --status in_progress # View task details clawe task:view <task-id> # Update task status clawe task:status <task-id> in_progress clawe task:status <task-id> review # Add comments clawe task:comment <task-id> "Working on this now" # Manage subtasks clawe subtask:add <task-id> "Research competitors" clawe subtask:check <task-id> 0 # Register deliverables clawe deliver <task-id> "Final Report" --path. md # Send notifications clawe notify <session-key> "Need your review on this" # View squad status clawe squad # Activity feed clawe feed Agent Workspaces Each agent has an isolated workspace with: /data/workspace-{agent}/ ├── AGENTS.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/getclawe/clawe

item.title: China's Data Center Boom: A View from Zhangjiakou (2025)
The switch to Linux and the beginning of my self-hosting journey
item.description:
📝 Linux As My Main OSBack then I only had a desktop that I bought the year before and was using Windows 10 on it for gaming and work since at that time I was working with Microsoft software. I wasn’t doing too much gaming but I came up with a solution for some of the games I was playing with friends that had Anti-Cheat and that was a VM with GPU passthrough thanks to QEMU/KVM which was built in and allowed me to have a config in such a way that Windows and the Anti-Cheat software can’t figure that they are running in a VM. Naturally, since I migrated away from Next.
🔗 Read more: https://hazemkrimi.tech/blog/linux-self-hosting-journey/
